name: smwgraphics-gokujou-parodius-snes-candy-land
title: Gokujou Parodius (SNES) - Candy Land
description:
The backgrounds seen in the third stage of Gokujou Parodius, for the SNES. Compared to the old version, it is slightly more optimized and has a better looping.

Includes two versions. One is used in the first portion of Candy Land, while the other variant is used in the other half. Pick the one you like more.

It's a food-themed background, as the appearance and title of the submission suggest. A good fit for food or castle themed levels.
